 Daily Excelsior 
 04:01 AM Nov 10, 2026 IST 
 Excelsior Correspondent
 LEH, Nov 9: The Administration of the Union Territory of Ladakh has increased the Dearness Allowance (DA) for Government employees from 262 per cent to 269 per cent of Basic Pay, with effect from July 1, 2026.
 An order in this regard was issued by the Finance Department today, in pursuance of the Ministry of Finance, Government of India’s notification.
 Advertisement 
 Follow the Daily Excelsior channel on WhatsApp  
 The revised DA will be applicable to employees continuing to draw their salaries in the pre-revised pay scales and Grade Pay under the 6th Central Pay Commission (CPC).
 The order also states that fractions of 50 paise and above will be rounded off to the next higher rupee, while amounts below 50 paise will be ignored.
